notes.title: Brute Horse: Watch the Wild New Trailer & Wishlist on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hey there, fellow adventurers!
Grab your snacks, secure your seat, and get ready—because we’re beyond excited to unveil the brand-new trailer for our next game, Brute Horse! 

[previewyoutube=4I39Q0B0Um0;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Welcome to [b]South Vulgaria[/b]!
A land of wonders, mysteries, and... well, absolute chaos. Join our three unlikely heroes—Brute, Michelle, and Horse (yes, that’s his name, don’t question it)—as they embark on an epic quest to track down the Legendary Veterinarian and save their dear, four-legged friend. No pressure, right?
 
[b]Expect the Unexpected![/b]
While navigating the totally hospitable wastelands of South Vulgaria, you’ll encounter puzzles, obstacles, and enemies who really don’t want you there. But hey, what’s an adventure without a few bizarre challenges?

[b]Couch Co-op Shenanigans![/b]
Feeling a little nervous about tackling these treacherous lands solo? No worries! We’ve got your back with co-op mode. Grab a friend, a partner (consensually, of course), and conquer the different kingdoms together! Because, as they say, misery loves company—especially in the wastelands of Vulgaria.

[b]What’s Next?![/b]
We’re still fine-tuning all the awesomeness before the full release, but don’t worry—we’ll be dropping a demo soon  so you can get a taste of the action before launch! Stay tuned for updates, surprises, and possibly a few questionable life choices from our heroes.

Your support means the world to us, so don’t forget to Wishlist the game on Steam and follow us on social media to stay in the loop. Trust us, you won’t want to miss a thing!
See you in Vulgaria, brave souls! 🐴🔥
